platform.provider_agreement_versions_v1.immutable: No UPDATE/DELETE; corrections append a new version and atomically move head under writer lock
platform.provider_agreement_versions_v1.date_constraint: valid_until is null or valid_until > valid_from

tenant_guard_requirement: Existing parent PKs alone do not prove matching tenant. Before acceptance, an actual Core-owned constraint-trigger/writer must verify Workspace and party tenant against canonical parents, lock them, and reject mismatch; no placeholder function is supplied or claimed installed.
writer_protocol_requirement: All agreement/version/scope/date/status/revoke writers must lock the same agreement head FOR UPDATE, preserve immutable version rows and bump head revision atomically. Party/Workspace invalidators must participate in the same canonical lock/revision protocol. Writer implementation and lock-order/admission proof remain separate gates; no reader-created or repaired rows.
reader_lock_order_proposal: existing Core host locks and authority revision SHARE
date_policy_proposal: UTC calendar date; start inclusive, end exclusive; read clock from server after waits. This is a new proposal because the existing date ABI does not specify timezone/end-day semantics; do not silently import Maintenance inclusive ends_on or subscription policies.
version_policy: Reader compares requested version to canonical head current version. Disclosable mismatch returns not_effective with actual current version; SERVICE maps version mismatch to conflict. Withheld never reveals a version. Head revision tracks revoke/scope/status currentness and is not substituted for agreement content version.
acl_proposal: Closed new objects, no public/anon/authenticated/service_role positive rights or schema exposure. Explicit OC1 closure in creation transaction; no default privileges mutation. Reviewed Core server reader principal/owner needed before any installation; no assumed postgres/superuser/provider grant.
rls_proposal: New tables require enabled+forced RLS and reviewed exact reader/writer policies. None is installed or replaced by an always-allow policy. No product evaluator changes.

decisions.topic: Accept minimum canonical store/version/revoke/writer protocol and its future inactive DDL review; canonical persistence currently absent

Exact disclosure policy for provider agreement metadata under services.orders.request, plus UTC/exclusive date semantics or explicit alternative. Request action permission alone does not authorize this disclosure.
